wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/phpt/extract.py: """Extracts the runnable body of php-src `.phpt` tests into standalone `.php` files.

php's own test suite is the specification, so running it through BOTH implementations and
diffing is a far better oracle than any hand-written probe. The `--EXPECT--` sections are
ignored on purpose: `php -n` is the oracle, which sidesteps `--EXPECTF--` wildcards entirely
and measures the interpreter actually installed rather than what the file claims.

Skipped, with the reason recorded so nothing is silently dropped:
- `--SKIPIF--` bodies that need an extension elephc does not target,
- tests needing externa
